>>A<< TRANSAXLE ASSEMBLY INSTALLATION
CAUTION
On the pull-type clutch, do not roll the transaxle assembly 
when installing it to the engine. If the transaxle assembly 
is rolled, the wedge collar and the wire ring will be 
deformed, causing a clutch malfunction due to improper 
engagement of the wedge collar and the wire ring.
